title: Summarize Records in a Data List
overview: A #Data List is configured to display open Opportunities with Q: Summary Fields calculating the opportunity count alongside the total, average, minimum, and maximum amounts. The summary reflects selected rows, or the current page when no rows are selected.
generalUseCase: Use Q: Summary Fields in a #Data List to summarize the overall characteristics of a set of records through aggregate functions, including SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, and COUNT.

walkthrough.step: Set Summary Fields in Data List Settings
